title: This $15 million New York home almost disappears into the forest on its 19.5-acre wooded estate
summary_full: Nestled in Pound Ridge, New York, this extraordinary home is listed for fifteen million dollars. Its mirrored facade seamlessly merges with the lush forest while reflecting the beauty of each season. Crafted by KieranTimberlake, the design emphasizes harmony with nature. Inside, expansive glass walls invite vibrant woodland views, creating a tranquil indoor-outdoor flow. This distinctive residence promises both privacy and proximity to New York City.
